Research work broadly lies in areas of Precision Medicine, Omics Biomarkers, High Dimensional Statistics, and ML. Publication in progress. Built fully reproducible pipeline using R {mstate, survival}, Excel and Stata. Managed modeling architecture development, literature review, construction of analysis-ready data and modeling. Delivered critical data-driven insights for government agricultural planning and policymaking.

title: Experience

content: Multi-Omics Prognostic Biomarker Identification (Master’s Thesis) R Survival Analysis Machine Learning Preprocessed 57,000 multi-omics features across 439 Lung Adenocarcinoma (LUAD) patients, applying Cox Sure Independence Screening (Cox-SIS) to filter high-dimensional noise down to 288 candidate targets. Trained penalized Cox regression and ensemble survival models using 100-subsample Stability Selection to reliably isolate robust prognostic biomarkers. Derived a 9-gene consensus biomarker panel and validated patient risk stratification through cross-validated Harrell's C-Index and log-rank tests. Stacked Ensemble Prediction of Fatal Myocardial Infarction Complications R Machine Learning Addressed severe clinical outcome class imbalance using SMOTE and selected the top 22 most informative predictors from 111 variables via LASSO and Random Forest Recursive Feature Elimination (RF-RFE). Trained multiple baseline models (Logistic Regression, kNN, Gradient Boosting, Random Forest, and XGBoost) with 10-fold cross-validation, ensembling predictions via GLM and Random Forest meta-learners. Achieved 0.87 test accuracy, 0.93 F1-score, and 0.81 ROC-AUC with the stacked Random Forest architecture, attaining 97.4% sensitivity in identifying fatal cases. Unsupervised Transcriptomic Subgroup Discovery in Leukemia Python Machine Learning Filtered 22,000 microarray gene probes down to the top 1,000 high-variance features and extracted lower-dimensional transcriptomic embeddings using PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP. Clustered the reduced feature space using K-Means, Agglomerative Hierarchical Clustering, and Gaussian Mixture Models (GMM), reaching 0.85 Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) with a BIC-optimized 8-cluster GMM. Identified 988 statistically significant subgroup biomarker probes via ANOVA F-testing with Benjamini-Hochberg False Discovery Rate (FDR) correction. Survival Analysis of Systolic Blood Pressure & Mortality SAS Survival Analysis Analyzed 22-year longitudinal mortality data across 2,000 Framingham Heart Study cohort patients using multivariate Cox Proportional Hazards modeling and AIC-driven stepwise selection. Evaluated Proportional Hazards assumptions via Schoenfeld residuals and time-varying diagnostic plots, resolving detected violations through age stratification. Estimated an adjusted Hazard Ratio (aHR) of 1.014 (p < 0.0001), quantifying a 1.4% increase in mortality risk per unit increase in systolic blood pressure. Financial Time Series Forecasting and Risk Analysis Python Time Series Deep Learning Preprocessed and engineered 10 years of historical market data for equity and fixed-income assets (TSLA, SPY, and BND), computing rolling volatility and return statistics. Built and tuned comparative time series forecasting pipelines evaluating classical statistical models (ARIMA and SARIMA) against deep learning architectures (LSTM).
summary: Statistical learning, machine learning, and computational biology projects.
